{"text":"ItemID: 1; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Relevant to my electronics setup, but I already have an HDMI cable and have no clear need for another.
ItemID: 2; Title: Amazon Basics Toslink Digital Optical Audio Cable, Multi-Channel, for Audio System, Sound Bar, Home Theatre, Gold-Plated Connectors, 9.8 Foot, Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent purchases do not suggest a sound bar or optical-audio setup that needs this connection.
ItemID: 3; Title: Logitech K400 Plus Wireless Touch With Easy Media Control and Built-in Touchpad, HTPC Keyboard for PC-connected TV, Windows, Android, Chrome OS, Laptop, Tablet - Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A keyboard with a touchpad fits my Raspberry Pi interests, but my Rii keyboard already serves that purpose.
ItemID: 4; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am currently more interested in computer and networking accessories than a dedicated streaming device.
ItemID: 5; Title: TP-Link 24 Port Gigabit Ethernet Switch | Desktop/ Rackmount | Limited Lifetime Protection | Plug & Play | Shielded Ports | Sturdy Metal | Fanless Quiet | Traffic Optimization | Unmanaged (TL-SG1024S); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Wired networking interests me, but 24 ports seem excessive for the needs reflected in my recent purchases.
ItemID: 6; Title: Samsung SSD 860 EVO 4TB 2.5 Inch SATA III Internal SSD (MZ-76E4T0B/AM); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current storage-upgrade project or confirmed need for a 4TB internal drive.
ItemID: 7; Title: Cat 6 Ethernet Cable 1 Ft (6Pack), Outdoor&Indoor, 10Gbps Support Cat7 Network, Heavy Duty Flat Internet LAN Patch Cord, Solid High Speed Weatherproof Cable for Router, Modem, Xbox, PS4, Switch, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: These fit my wired-networking interests, but I just bought five Ethernet cables and the one-foot length may be limiting.
ItemID: 8; Title: Cable Matters 2-Pack USB to USB Extension Cable 6 ft (USB 3.0 Extension Cable/USB Extender) in Blue for Webcam, VR Headset, Printer, Hard Drive and More - 6 Feet; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The longer reach and USB 3.0 support could make my laptop peripherals easier to position, extending the usefulness of my earlier USB extension purchase.
ItemID: 9; Title: Kingston 1.92TB A400 SATA 3 2.5" Internal SSD SA400S37/1920G - HDD Replacement for Increase Performance; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A computer upgrade could interest me later, but I have not identified a compatible machine that needs this drive now.
ItemID: 10; Title: 64GB EVO Select Memory Card and Sabrent SuperSpeed 2-Slot USB 3.0 Flash Memory Card Reader; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Additional removable storage and a USB 3.0 reader would be useful for my Raspberry Pi projects, after checking the card's compatibility."}
